messages:
elaine (partnerships): Heads-up: we need a compact GTM matrix for the marketplace launch that covers cloud vendors, HW partners, and SI integrations. Focus: sequence of partner spotlights, joint press, and tenant onboarding windows.
mike (product): Agree. Can we aim to lock the sequence and owners by Tue EOD? Key constraints: legal approvals, SI test windows, and marketplace listing cutover.
jen (marketing): I can coordinate the blog sequence. Thinking: 1) partner spotlight (partner A) Tue 11:00 PT, 2) marketplace launch Thu 14:00 PT, 3) deeper partner technical post Fri. Need logos + co-auth sign-off by Mon noon.
omar (comms): Also need partner press contacts and embargo exceptions. If any partner requests earlier announcement, we'll handle offline. Drafting joint press release template now.
nina (eng): For SI integrations, we need a short validation checklist (health checks, rate-limit profile, sample payloads). Can someone confirm expected QPS per partner?
rufus (si): From SI side: minimum 2 engineers for the staging window; require 36h notice. Proposed staging slot: Wed 13:009:00 PT (overnight) or Thu 07:00110:00 PT (morning). Which is preferred?
elaine (partnerships): Let's not overload ops. Proposal: single consolidated staging day Wed 09:008:00 PT for all SI smoke tests, plus an A/B cutover rehearsal Thu 08:309:30 PT.
mike (product): That works. I'll publish a compact partner readiness checklist and tag owners. It'll include SSO, API keys, logo asset, quote, and sample traffic profile.
jen (marketing): Quick ask: partners A & B asked for co-authored blog vs. partner quote. Which approach should we take? Co-auth needs partner legal to sign off earlier.
omar (comms): Recommend partner quote on the marketplace launch, co-authored deep-dive later. Reduces legal friction. I'll prepare a quote template with placeholders.
nina (eng): Technical note: if partners bring large models, we need to know quantization/instance size to reserve capacity. Otherwise we risk throttling on staging.
rufus (si): I'll collect model size and expected payloads during our intake. Also flagging that certain SI tools need VPN access for private deploy testing. 72h lead for VPN.
elaine (partnerships): Action items summary:
- jen (marketing): blog schedule + hero assets by Mon 15:00 PT
- omar (comms): press template + partner contacts list by Mon 12:00 PT
- mike (product): publish partner checklist + owners by Mon 18:00 PT
- nina + ops: confirm capacity and staging booking by Tue 10:00 PT
- rufus (si): collect SI engineer list + VPN needs by Tue 12:00 PT
launch-bot: Reminder: marketplace-lint job scheduled for 2026-02-17T16:00:00Z for thread 4398765432 :bell:
mike (product): I'll also add a short fallback policy: if a partner miss approvals, we launch without the partner badge and add them in a phased cadence.
jen (marketing): For social, propose 1-hour coordinated push at launch, plus partner RTs. Need final one-liner from partners by Wed 09:00 PT.
omar (comms): Also recommend a post-launch monitor call Fri 10:00 PT to surface any PR escalations. I'll calendar invite stakeholders.
nina (eng): Providing a tiny health-check curl for SI teams:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/v1/ping -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"workspace":"test","payload":"ok"}'
```
rufus (si): A note: for hardware partners, we need to verify listing metadata (SKU, region availability). I'll send a small metadata template to jamal.
elaine (partnerships): I'll stitch these into a single run-of-show doc and circulate by Tue 09:00 PT. If no blockers by Tue 17:00 PT we lock Thurs 14:00 PT as launch time. :rocket:
